title: Fresh food thermistor fault
shortDescription: Refrigerator compartment temperature sensor reads out of range.
fullDescription: E1 on Fisher & Paykel RF series fridges indicates the fresh-food thermistor is reporting a short or open circuit. Temperature control falls back to default cooling to protect contents, but food may warm up.

faq.a: Check temperature — move perishables if above 40 F.

title: Freezer thermistor fault
shortDescription: Freezer temperature sensor out of range.
fullDescription: E2 means the freezer compartment thermistor is reporting an invalid value. Freezer may overcool or warm depending on default fallback behavior. Service call to replace.

title: Evaporator fan fault
shortDescription: Evaporator fan motor stalled or not reporting RPM.
fullDescription: E3 on Fisher & Paykel fridges indicates the evaporator fan is not running at expected RPM. Ice buildup from a defrost failure can jam the fan blade. Allow manual defrost and clear the coils.

fixSteps.title: Manual defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 24 hours, allow coils to thaw.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove back freezer panel, check fan blade.

whenToCallPro: If fan still does not run.

faq.a: Defrost system failure leads to ice buildup.

title: Defrost heater fault
shortDescription: Defrost heater did not reach expected temperature.
fullDescription: E4 indicates the defrost heater or its fuse is not conducting. Over time ice accumulates on the evaporator and cooling performance drops. Replace heater or fuse per service manual.

faq.a: Yes, temporary measure while waiting for service.

title: Compressor fault
shortDescription: Compressor relay or inverter reports fault.
fullDescription: E5 is raised when the variable-speed compressor inverter does not start or reports over-current. Sealed system service required.

faq.a: Depends on age — compressor replacement is expensive.

title: Door ajar too long
shortDescription: Door has been open beyond the alarm timeout.
fullDescription: E6 or the door-alarm icon on F&P fridges means a door has been open for longer than 2 minutes. Close door to clear; if door is closed but code persists, inspect the reed switch and door gasket alignment.

fixSteps.title: Inspect switch
fixSteps.instruction: Locate magnetic reed switch near hinge; test with magnet.

title: High temperature alarm
fullDescription: E7 / high temp alarm means internal temperature has risen above safe limits — often after a power outage, door left open, or overloaded fridge. Close door, remove obstructions, and allow 4 hours to recover.

fixSteps.title: Wait 4 hours
fixSteps.instruction: Allow fridge to pull down temperature.

whenToCallPro: If alarm persists after recovery period.
videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel fridge high temp alarm

faq.a: Discard perishables held above 40 F for over 4 hours.

title: Ice maker fault
fullDescription: E8 indicates a fault in the built-in ice maker — commonly a stuck ejector arm, no water supply, or a failed motor. Verify water line is connected and dispensing.

fixSteps.title: Check water
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure supply line is open and dispenser gives water.

fixSteps.title: Clear jam
fixSteps.instruction: Remove ice bin and clear any jammed cubes.

videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel fridge E8 ice maker

title: Water filter life expired
fullDescription: E9 or the filter icon illuminates every 6 months or after a set volume to prompt filter replacement. Install a genuine F&P filter and reset the indicator.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Twist out old cartridge, install new.

title: Main control board communication error
shortDescription: Display PCB has lost communication with main control.
fullDescription: E10 indicates UI-to-main board communication fault. Power cycle resolves transient issues. Persistent E10 needs service.

title: Temperature alarm active
shortDescription: Compartment warmer than setpoint for extended period.
fullDescription: The temperature alarm beeps and shows an icon when internal temp exceeds setpoint for more than 1 hour. Review door habits, ambient temperature, and cooling system health.
whenToCallPro: If alarm does not clear after 2 hours of closed operation.

faq.a: 4 hours above 40 F — discard perishables after.

title: Fridge in Sabbath mode
shortDescription: Display and interior lights are disabled — this is intentional.
fullDescription: Sabbath mode on F&P fridges disables display, interior lights, and alarms for religious observance. Cooling continues normally. Deactivate by holding the designated button sequence in the manual.

fixSteps.title: Exit Sabbath
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Freezer + Alarm buttons 3 seconds (check manual for model).
